from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,stat,sys,sysconfig
def read_pin(path):
    path=Path(path); fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_CLOEXEC|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK)
    try:
        first=os.fstat(fd); named=path.lstat()
        keys=lambda s:(s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_mode,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns)
        assert stat.S_ISREG(first.st_mode) and first.st_size>0 and keys(first)==keys(named)
        chunks=[]; remaining=first.st_size+1
        while remaining:
            raw=os.read(fd,min(1048576,remaining))
            if not raw:break
            chunks.append(raw);remaining-=len(raw)
        raw=b''.join(chunks)
        assert len(raw)==first.st_size and keys(first)==keys(os.fstat(fd))==keys(path.lstat())
    finally:os.close(fd)
    return {'path':str(path),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        'mode':stat.S_IMODE(first.st_mode),'device':first.st_dev,'inode':first.st_ino,
        'mtime_ns':first.st_mtime_ns,'ctime_ns':first.st_ctime_ns}
assert sys.version_info[:3]==(3,14,4) and sys.flags.optimize==0
executable=Path(sys.executable).resolve(strict=True)
assert os.readlink('/proc/self/exe')==str(executable)
config={name:sysconfig.get_config_var(name) for name in ('Py_ENABLE_SHARED','LDLIBRARY','INSTSONAME')}
rows=[]
for line in Path('/proc/self/maps').read_bytes().splitlines():
    fields=line.split(maxsplit=5)
    if len(fields)!=6:continue
    name=os.fsdecode(fields[5])
    if not name.removesuffix(' (deleted)').rsplit('/',1)[-1].startswith('libpython'):continue
    assert name.startswith('/') and not name.endswith(' (deleted)') and '\\' not in name
    assert Path(name).name in (config['LDLIBRARY'],config['INSTSONAME'])
    device=fields[3].split(b':')
    rows.append((name,int(device[0],16),int(device[1],16),int(fields[4]),b'x' in fields[1]))
assert config['Py_ENABLE_SHARED']==1 and len({r[:4] for r in rows})==1 and any(r[4] for r in rows)
library=read_pin(rows[0][0]); executable_binding=read_pin(executable)
assert all(r[1:4]==(os.major(library['device']),os.minor(library['device']),library['inode']) for r in rows)
context={'schema':'hepta.hia.roundtrip-runtime-launch-context.v1','launch_executable':sys.executable,
    'executable':executable_binding,'python':sys.version,'version':list(sys.version_info[:3]),
    'prefix':sys.prefix,'base_prefix':sys.base_prefix,'sysconfig':config,'library':library,
    'library_directory':str(Path(library['path']).parent)}
print(json.dumps({'schema':'hepta.hia.roundtrip-actual-runtime-probe.v1','context':context,
    'flags':{'isolated':sys.flags.isolated,'ignore_environment':sys.flags.ignore_environment,
             'dont_write_bytecode':sys.flags.dont_write_bytecode,'optimize':sys.flags.optimize},
    'loader_environment':{name:os.environ.get(name) for name in ('LD_LIBRARY_PATH','LD_PRELOAD')}},sort_keys=True))
